purpose: Separate semantic evidence, prediction quality, holding logic and costs; test active candidates without leverage or live orders
execution: Completed five-minute bar decisions, fixed integer targets for next open, scheduled 15:55 liquidation
training: Daily prior mature labels, fixed regularization and feature definition; no search or outcome-selected coefficients
primary_measure: Absolute net PnL after all assumed execution costs
controls: Frozen A, C and B at 2/5bps; text ablations on the same C price predictions and clocks
selection: Report all candidates, including losses; no automatic promotion and no retuning on these outputs
future_validation: Ten new complete sessions for candidate assessment followed by twenty new sessions with locked rules; calendar passage and actual captures required
limitations: Development performance cannot establish future profitability
No verified spread, impact, short availability or borrow fee reconstruction
Frozen A training prohibits evaluation of A before 2026-09-14
Current universe is not a historical security master

cloud.runner: GitHub standard ubuntu-latest in the existing public repository
